name: Moon Island: The Last Strand
storyline:
A hero possesses immeasurable power of unknown origin, attracting the attention of powerful entities. To get their hands on it, they need to understand where it comes from and how to replicate it. In the wrong hands, this power could lead to the end of humanity, and the only one able to stop it is the hero who holds its very source.

After waking up from a revealing dream, M, the hero, must uncover the origin of this power while the planet collapses, and figure out how much of it is still left.
summary: A first-person, story-driven adventure about M, a hero who bears an unknown power that powerful entities want to understand and replicate. As the planet collapses, M must uncover the origin of this power and stop it from ending humanity. The game is linear, features interactive environments and a few challenges, and was made for the Moonmoon Twitch community.
